description: This file contains implementation code for generating CPU configuration arguments for crosvm in a virtual machine environment, including functions for serializing frequency domains and constructing argument vectors based on JSON configuration input.

methods.name: SerializeFreqDomains
methods.description: Serializes a map of frequency domains into a JSON-like string format.

methods.name: CrosvmCpuArguments
methods.description: Generates a list of command-line arguments for configuring vCPUs based on JSON input.
